title: 第5章 从1080p到8k的转变第6章 必须交房租
content_zh:
;;
“哈~~~”
“老张，怎么这么困啊？”
“困才是常态好吧。”
餐厅里，云阳的舍友张古伸了个懒腰说道：“清醒也只不过是一场噩梦罢了。”
“老张你咋变得和阳哥似的了？”另一个舍友赵江说道。
“欸！别瞎说哈，你们看阳哥。”
“嗯？”原本只是安静啃包子的云阳突然听见自己被cue道，疑惑的看向cue自己的舍友薛子杰，问道：“我咋了？”
“平常这个时候阳哥你已经开始哈欠连天了，但今天却感觉你精神矍铄，精神头十足的模样啊。”
被薛子杰这么一说，云阳也突然发现，自己明明通宵了一个晚上，却没有半点困乏的感觉，反而感觉异常清醒。
这难道是通宵过后的“回光返照”？
“可能……是我昨天通宵的缘故吧。”
“……”
同桌吃饭的舍友们不由得一愣，心道：你这是说的什么话？
以前你天天困的哈欠连天，然后通宵还让你通出精神头来了？
通宵修仙是吧？越修越精神？
四人一边互相吐槽一边快速将早餐卷进肚子里，看了眼时间离上课还有十分钟，不过还好食堂离第一堂课的教室不远，跑跑十分钟也来得及。
这个时间点，教室后排早就满人了，云阳等人只能找了个中间靠前的位置坐着。
普通大学就是这个样子的，大部分都是来混日子的，就算是打算认真上课的学生大多也只会坐在相对靠前的位置。
第一排大多数时间都是空出来的。

第一节课上高数，老实说早晨八点上高数那真是种折磨，本来课堂内容就让人昏昏欲睡，这特么还是上的第一堂课。
双管齐下，这是真特么困啊！
我上早八！
教室里中前排部分认真听课的学生此时早已困的七仰八叉，哈欠连天了。
至于后排的学生们，此时他们正开小差开的开的不亦乐乎。
俗话说得好，打开金铲铲，运气好铲一把下课，运气不好多铲两把再下课也不亏。
金铲铲，实乃上课开小差之利器！
如果以往的云阳此时也该打开金铲铲了，他虽然坐在中前排，但只是习惯性的和舍友们坐一块罢了，他并不是那种会好好听课的人。
不过今天云阳并没有打开游戏，因为他发现自己今天的精神头好的出奇，不管老师讲的内容有多枯燥，自己竟然没有丝毫困意，大脑也没有任何抗拒知识进入的感觉。
相反，云阳感觉自己就像脑袋里被塞了一片薄荷叶似的，感觉无比清爽。
而且自己的视力似乎也变得极好，云阳是有点轻微近视的，到不了戴眼镜的程度，但坐在后排看黑板还是会觉得黑板有些模糊的。
但现在云阳却能看清黑板上的所有字迹，甚至连字迹上的粉尘云阳都能看得清。
吃早饭的时候云阳就隐隐约约的有这种感觉了，但当时云阳并没有太在意，只当是清晨露水多，阳光反射的多所以才有好像看的更清晰而已。
但现在有了黑板这个对照，云阳才发现，自己的视力确确实实是变好了。
所见到的世界确实是清晰了。
大概就像把视频的清晰度从1080p一下子切换到8k的感觉。
“嘶~”
云阳倒吸一口凉气，这合理吗？
不懂就问千度，云阳立刻在浏览器上开始搜索“视力突然变好”相关的问题。
结果却搜出来一堆眼科医院的广告。

以及一些看着不怎么靠谱的诊断报告。
为什么明明自己的视力变好了，可这诊断报告里却说自己快死了？
……
果然千度总是这样一针见血，而且直达问题的核心。

"Ha~~~"
"Lao Zhang, why are you so sleepy?"
"It's normal to be sleepy, okay."
In the restaurant, Yunyang's roommate Zhang Gu stretched himself and said, "It's just a nightmare when you wake up."
"Lao Zhang, why have you become like Brother Yang?" said another roommate, Zhao Jiang.
"Hey! Stop talking nonsense, look at Brother Yang."
"Huh?" Yunyang, who was just quietly chewing on the buns, suddenly heard that he was being cueed. He looked at his roommate Xue Zijie who was cueing him doubtfully and asked, "What's wrong with me?"
"Usually at this time, Brother Yang, you have already started to yawn, but today I feel that you are in good spirits and full of energy."
After Xue Zijie said this, Yunyang suddenly realized that he had stayed up all night, but he didn't feel sleepy at all. Instead, he felt extremely awake.
Is this a "reflection" after a long night?
"Maybe... it's because I stayed up all night yesterday."
"..."
The roommates who were eating at the same table couldn't help but be stunned and thought to themselves: What are you talking about?
You used to be so sleepy every day that you yawned all day long, and then it kept you awake all night?
Staying up all night cultivating, right? The more you practice, the more energetic you become?
The four of them complained to each other while quickly eating breakfast. They looked at the time and saw that there were still ten minutes before class. Fortunately, the cafeteria was not far from the classroom where the first class was held, and they could still run for ten minutes.
At this time, the back row of the classroom was already full, so Yunyang and others could only find a seat in the middle and front.
Ordinary universities are like this. Most of them are here to hang out. Even students who plan to take classes seriously will only sit relatively near the front.
The first row is vacant most of the time.
The first class is advanced mathematics. To be honest, taking advanced mathematics at eight o'clock in the morning is really torture. The content of the class can make people sleepy, but this is the first class.
Two-pronged approach, this is really sleepy!
I'll go to bed at eight in the morning!
Some of the students in the front row of the classroom who were listening carefully were already lying on their backs and yawning profusely.
As for the students in the back row, they were running around happily at this time.
As the saying goes, if you open the golden shovel, if you are lucky, you will be dismissed if you shovel one. If you are not lucky, you will be dismissed if you shovel two more.
The golden shovel is really a weapon for distracting students during class!
In the past, Yunyang would have opened the golden spatula at this time. Although he sat in the middle and front row, he just sat with his roommates habitually. He was not the kind of person who would listen to lectures well.
However, Yunyang did not open the game today because he found that he was surprisingly energetic today. No matter how boring the teacher's content was, he did not feel sleepy at all, and his brain did not feel any resistance to the entry of knowledge.
On the contrary, Yunyang felt as if a mint leaf had been stuffed into his head, feeling extremely refreshing.
Moreover, his eyesight seems to have become very good. Yunyang is slightly myopic, not enough to wear glasses, but when sitting in the back row and looking at the blackboard, he still feels that the blackboard is a bit blurry.
But now Yunyang can clearly see all the writing on the blackboard, and even the dust on the writing can be seen clearly.
Yunyang had a vague feeling like this when he was having breakfast, but Yunyang didn't pay much attention to it at that time. He just thought that there was a lot of dew in the morning and the sun reflected more, so he seemed to see more clearly.
But now with the blackboard as a comparison, Yunyang discovered that his eyesight had indeed improved.
The world I see is indeed clear.
It's probably like switching the resolution of the video from 1080p to 8k all at once.
"Hiss~"
Yunyang took a breath, is this reasonable?
If he didn’t understand, he asked Qiandu, and Yunyang immediately started searching on the browser for questions related to “sudden improvement of eyesight”.
As a result, a bunch of advertisements for eye hospitals were found.
and some that don’t look likeWhat a reliable diagnostic report.
Why does the diagnosis report say that I am about to die even though my eyesight has improved?
…
Sure enough, Qiandu always hit the nail on the head and went straight to the core of the problem.
